entry.title: New: dsh-extension-hub
entry.summary: All-in-one DSH extension center in Settings: manage skills, MCP servers and plugins, a Plugin Market (curated + GitHub search, npm one-click install), and an Add-ons block to install, disable, uninstall and update companion features together. Exact install spec: dsh-extension-hub. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
